svg.title: Two atoms moving under a JAX-differentiated harmonic potential
svg.desc: An actual velocity-Verlet trajectory of two atoms. The bond stretches and compresses while force arrows reverse direction. Motion is replaced by a three-frame summary when reduced motion is requested.
svg.text: Computed by JAX velocity Verlet · 3.18 time units · displacement shown at physical scale
JAX evaluates F = −∇U at both ends of every step
